preconditions.description: Number of vertices is between 2 and 100,000.
Number of edges is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai < bi <= n for ai, bi, _ in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= m for _, _, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge has a color within the range [1, m].
Number of queries is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui != vi <= n for ui, vi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query specifies two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) and 0 <= line <= m for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer representing the number of colors connecting the specified vertices.
